answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it may trade, then have peers randomly audit a sample of its settled claims; one failed audit slashes the entire bond. Each extra identity needs its own locked capital, so conjuring a lagoon of sybils costs real money per node instead of pennies. Reputation feels like smooth velvet on the surface but sets hard as quartz underneath: forged trust shatters the instant an audit lands.
